title: Playtest checklist
summary: M2 is the first drive: the browser game's vehicles in Unity, the bog that ruts and grabs, and a real big-block V8 that follows your foot.
tryThis: Double-click Play.bat. You start in the truck at the Millbrook garage.
Drive with W A S D (or the arrow keys); Space is the handbrake. C switches between the chase and hood cameras.
Take Route 9 to the fuel station, the dirt road to the farm, then drive into the bog: it ruts and grabs like the browser game.
At the garage, drive up beside another vehicle and press E to switch into it. L lights, H horn, G winch. Esc pauses and has Settings and Controls; F1 shows the controls; your settings are remembered.
Esc, then Engine Bench, to hear the truck's V8 on its own and run a dyno sweep.

items.text: Does it handle like the browser game? (say what feels different in the comment)
Does the sound follow your foot?
Does the truck sound like a big gas V8?
Does the bog rut and grab like the browser game?
Any crackles or dropouts in the engine sound?

knownIssues: This is still the old Millbrook. From M3 the game moves to the new town (real Stockport, Ohio, renamed Millbrook).
Junctions are plain overlapping road ribbons and lots are the old round gravel pads; M3 replaces both.
Vehicles have no collisions with each other or with buildings yet (M3).
The other vehicles use the browser game's engine sounds mapped to the new engines; only the truck has its real V8.
